text:
Asha Patel: Quick shout — SyntheticCare just finished their pilot using our Embedded SDK for in-app clinical triage. Live in a limited rollout this morning, planning GA in ~2 weeks. :tada:
Marco Ruiz: Amazing! Any early numbers on latency or cost impact?
Asha Patel: Early telemetry shows median latency down ~45ms vs their previous hosted call pattern, and token spend expected to drop ~18% once prefix caching is enabled. Numbers still preliminary.
Izzy Chen: Love this. Can we get screenshots + a short quote for a partner blog? I'll draft a 300–400 word case blurb if product can share a snippet of results.
Gabe Morris: Shared a quick note in the integration ticket — they enabled KV prefix caching + continuous batching, and switched to our 8-bit quantized runtime for certain flows. The pilot ran at 250rps with consistent p95 under 220ms.
Asha Patel: @Izzy yep, SyntheticCare legal signed off on a short quote. I'll pull the quote and anonymized metrics into the doc by EOD.
Marco Ruiz: Who led the engineering side on our end so I can loop them into the exec call with the partner? Need to prep for upsell conversation next quarter.
Gabe Morris: I coordinated engineering support with the integrations team — cc'd integrations-bot for the rollout playbook link.
integrations-bot: Rollout playbook: https://internal.redwood/rollouts/embedded-sdk-playbook — checklist created, last updated 2026-02-11.
Izzy Chen: Drafting the partner highlight now. Can someone paste the pilot KPIs here (latency p50/p95, cost delta, requests/sec) so I don't have to fetch numbers from multiple places?
Gabe Morris: Quick paste: p50=68ms, p95=210ms, avg token cost -18%, sustained 250 rps, errors <0.2%.
Asha Patel: Perfect. @Izzy I'll send you the partner quote and a screenshot of their UI in the next hour. Marketing + Product sync at 4pm to finalize the case study and plan social + marketplace blurb.
Marco Ruiz: Awesome work team. Can we add a note to sales playbook about customers who should consider Embedded SDK vs Dedicated? Might help with positioned upsells.
Gabe Morris: Agreed — I'll add a short decision tree to the playbook after GA.
Izzy Chen: I'll draft the marketplace blurb for the ISV section and ping legal for approvals.
Asha Patel: Closing note — this is the first Embedded SDK pilot to cross 200rps in production for a partner. Huge win for partnerships + runtime teams. :rocket:
